summary: Phase 38 Session 1 (Work Order Rate Engine + Job Role Master + District LWE) — full backend + frontend testing. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass, including the 12-cell rate matrix (to 3-decimal precision), invalid-input rejection, district_id → center.is_lwe lookup, admin-only rate-config PATCH, Job Role Master CRUD + case-insensitive dedupe + soft-delete, and batch create/update authoritative recomputation that ignores frontend-sent bogus rates. Frontend: /batch-management shows 'Incomplete WO' amber badge on all 352 legacy batches; Create Batch dialog has full 'Work Order Allocation · Rate Engine' section with FY, Category (I/II/III), Job Role dropdown from master + '+' quick-add, Job Role Hours, No. of Candidate, read-only Per Hour Rate (with 'Base ₹X · slab XXX' subtitle) and read-only Total Work Order Value (with formula subtitle). Live recalc verified: FY 2026-27 + Cat I + 10 × 8h → ₹56.35 / ₹4,508; switching Cat → II updates to ₹52.50 / ₹4,200; changing JR hours (via auto-fill 6h from newly-added role) updates total to ₹3,150 = 10 × ₹52.50 × 6h. Add Job Role dialog auto-selects the new role and auto-fills default_hours.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~17,300 lines — extraction into modular routers is overdue (already flagged in earlier iterations).

BatchIn.job_role_hours / num_candidates / base_rate / final_rate / work_order_value fields have no upper-bound validation; consider sensible caps to prevent huge multiplication overflow-style values in DB.
GET /api/work-order/rate-config returns DEFAULT_RATE_SLABS in fallback path with different sort order semantics than the DB path (defaults are already ordered but no explicit sort). Non-critical.

PATCH /api/districts/{cid}/lwe is behind admin/manager/senior_manager but exposes the entire updated center doc including any sensitive internal fields — consider projecting only id + is_lwe + lwe_updated_at.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_WO_* batch (with FY 2026-27 + Cat I + LWE, verifying bogus rate override) and 1 TEST_LEGACY_* batch (no fy_year/category, verifying rate=0), plus 1 TEST_JR_* job role (soft-deleted after test) and 1 TEST_UI_JR_* job role (created via UI, remains active).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 38 Session 1 complete. Session 2 will add bulk batch creation using the same rate engine. Rate engine endpoints are stable and admin-gated where required. The test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter55_phase38_wo_rate_engine.py can be reused as regression baseline. Note: this app uses `centers` collection as the district source of truth (one row per district-center); /api/districts/{cid}/lwe operates on centers.
